jobs.name: Industrial Command
jobs.prompt:
Generate one premium full-screen portrait mobile tower-defense gameplay concept, not a phone mockup or marketing page. Show the complete playable screen with no exterior device bezel, title card, explanatory prose, extra screens, or collage. Portrait 9:16. The fully visible top-down 9-column by 14-row arena takes about 75 percent of the screen height, with compact HUD above and thumb-reachable controls below. Keep terrain quiet and the playfield unframed, with every cell visible. Original futuristic player machinery fights biological or biomechanical Brood, not medieval fantasy. Use crisp miniature silhouettes: narrow long Rail accelerator towers versus broad heavy Siege launchers; about 20 small distinct enemy shapes. Show a faded route through permanent numbered waypoints 1 and 2, a clear spawn and exit, and strategically placed tower blockers beside open paths. No tower or control obscures a waypoint or path. This is a between-wave planning state with a faint next-wave route and enemy forecast, not a results or menu screen. Show these short exact HUD labels once each: 'LIVES 20', 'WAVE 3/6', '85', '1x'. Include familiar pause and settings symbols. The lower command area has tower symbols with short labels 'Foundation', 'Rail', 'Siege', and one clear 'Launch' action. All text is large enough for a small phone. Controls must not cover the arena. Strong light-dark silhouette contrast, restrained effects, clean typography, no excessive bloom, glossy plastic, or decorative floating orbs. Use reference principles only: Infinitode's modular hierarchy, Geometry Wars' shape and energy separation, The Tower's economy of HUD. Do not copy their artwork or logos. Follow the specific layout, material and art direction below rather than making a generic recolor.

Specific direction: Industrial Command. Tactile industrial command screen: pale concrete arena tiles, graphite machinery, sparse cyan player energy and orange hazard accents. Compact top telemetry strip; three square tower controls at bottom left and one broad launch control bottom right. Beveled metal separators, small stamped numerals, and a restrained perimeter of damaged facility material. Near-orthographic shallow relief, not photorealism. Make the board and bottom command dock feel like one instrument.

jobs.name: Siege silhouettes
jobs.prompt:
Create one clean industrial-design silhouette exploration sheet containing EXACTLY TEN distinct stationary science-fiction siege defense towers. White background, solid black silhouettes, no color, shading, texture, gradients, cast shadows, scenery, muzzle flashes, smoke, effects, or decorative frames. Orthographic TOP-DOWN overhead view, front of every tower points UP. Use a 5-column by 2-row equal-cell layout, with generous gutters so shapes never touch. Each tower has a compact anchored foundation suitable for a single square game tile; no vehicles, wheels, or movable tank chassis. All shapes stay within their cell. Every option must have a genuinely different bold outer contour readable at 32 pixels. Minimal white negative spaces may define the barrel opening or separation, but no fine internal detail. SIEGE family: wide, squat, heavy explosive launchers, massive housings, short thick mortar barrels, broad recoil anchors. Family reads as concentrated mass, not a long rifle. Put only the numerals 01 through 10 centered below the respective silhouette, in reading order. No title, captions, extra glyphs, or repeated alternatives. Match these ten distinct concepts in order:
01. Bastion Mortar: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: broad circular armored body, short offset mortar tube, four compact stabilizer feet; heavy, explosive, unmistakably wider than long. No effects or tiny details.
02. Crater Drum: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: squat hexagonal drum chassis with a centered thick launch barrel and six blunt radial armor plates. Wide footprint, blunt mass, no effects or tiny details.
03. Anvil Lobber: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: wide anvil-shaped hull, rear counterweight, and a short forward-angled launcher. Strong asymmetry and dense mass; no effects or tiny details.
04. Tripod Howitzer: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: broad triangular armored platform with three long sturdy support legs and a central stubby howitzer. Distinct tripod geometry, no effects or tiny details.
05. Shell Foundry: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: wide rectangular industrial block with a circular loading well and a thick side-mounted launcher. Heavy workshop profile, no effects or tiny details.
06. Rampart Bell: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: large bell-like armored dome, squared rear housing, and one short central tube. Broad rounded mass with a clear front, no effects or tiny details.
07. Quarry Crawler: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: wide tracked rectangle, oversized circular turret, and stubby offset cannon. Low, grounded, and visibly heavy; no effects or tiny details.
08. Hexburst Cradle: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: six-sided cradle holding a thick vertical launcher pod, with two broad side braces. Wide symmetric blast platform, no effects or tiny details.
09. Breakwater Gun: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: wide crescent shield hull with a compact central bombard tube and two blocky rear anchors. Defensive, broad, explosive; no effects or tiny details.
10. Thunder Sump: Black-on-white top-down silhouette: broad low oval base, deep central firing cavity, and two thick diagonal recoil arms. Bold readable mass, no effects or tiny details.
